title: Reduction of the Wagstaff Chebyshev sufficiency conjecture to the Single-Pass Conjecture
description: Reproducibility bundle for the paper. For W_p = (2^p + 1)/3 and omega_3 = 3 + 2*sqrt(2), the congruence omega_3^{(W_p+1)/2} = -1 (mod W_p) (Condition II) holds for every prime W_p; whether it implies primality is the open Wagstaff Chebyshev sufficiency conjecture, the Chua-form counterpart of the Vrba-Reix Wagstaff primality test. Writing P_p for the set of primes r with ord_r(2) = 2p at which Condition (II) holds locally (every member divides W_p, and P_p = {W_p} when W_p is prime), the Single-Pass Conjecture (SPC) asserts |P_p| <= 1 for every prime p >= 5. The paper proves that SPC implies the sufficiency conjecture unconditionally and with zero computational inputs; the working chain PPPC + MPC^> + X1, with the Platinum enumeration (684,965,381 rows) and the witness discharges as stated computational inputs, also suffices and is implied by SPC. Proved unconditionally along the way: NCT for every odd d <= 400 (28 fixed-d certificates in (100,400]) and a complete danger-triple census through d = 400 (exactly two real triples, both at exponents closed by secondary factors). This bundle contains the LaTeX source (v4.0; v3.8 archived), the reproducibility scripts, the static NCT fixed-d certificates and the danger-census artifact (pinned factorizations, APR-CL certified).
